territories.name: Legal
territories.note: D+1: Google closes the gap with Microsoft after Gemini Enterprise for Legal preview. Harvey / specialists still strong on pure legal workflows.

territories.name: Financial Services
territories.note: Google pressure rises post-launch. Microsoft still leads on installed base; contest tightens.

territories.name: Healthcare
territories.note: Elevated to HOT: market anticipates Google Healthcare move; specialists and Microsoft already dense.

territories.name: Life Sciences
territories.note: Google horizon signal increases relative positioning. Governance needs still favor controlled platforms.

territories.name: Insurance
territories.note: Microsoft strong via existing enterprise footprint. Slow movement.

territories.name: Government
territories.note: Long cycles, high trust. Slight Google uptick; structure unchanged.

territories.name: Professional Services
territories.note: Google gains on playbook-adjacent work. Microsoft Copilot still primary distribution.

territories.name: Retail
territories.note: Still on Google roadmap. Early positioning drift only.

na.note: Microsoft still densest in NA, but Google Legal/FS launch compresses the gap. Intensity slightly down as contest rises.

sa.note: Microsoft still leads; lower overall enterprise AI maturity.

eu.note: Microsoft footprint remains; Google regulated push and Anthropic safety deals keep EU contested.

af.note: Emerging. Microsoft and Google competing for public sector and banking.

as.note: Google Cloud strong in APAC; slight intensity rise after industry-solution narrative.

oc.note: Microsoft dominant in Australia/NZ. Google increasing presence.

events.text: No material public signal; board remains unchanged.
D+1 snapshot: Google closes Legal gap with Microsoft; Healthcare elevated to HOT as market prices next vertical.
Google launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal + Financial Services. Roadmap: Healthcare, Life Sciences, Retail.
Menlo Ventures (late 2025): Anthropic ~40% enterprise LLM spend, OpenAI ~27%, Google ~21%.
Microsoft continues strong horizontal distribution via M365 Copilot in regulated industries.
